calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS n_current_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_current_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS members_multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)) AS members_no_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>'9999-12-31') AS cur_but_closed,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to='9999-12-31') AS notcur_but_open
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current

calls.statement:
SELECT s.tier AS stg_tier, s.is_current AS stg_current, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT s.member_id) AS members, min(s.valid_from), max(s.valid_from), 
 sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_in_dim,
 sum(CASE WHEN c.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_in_dim,
 sum(CASE WHEN c.tier <> s.tier THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differs_from_current
FROM stg_member_updates s
LEFT JOIN dim_member d ON d.member_key = s.member_key
LEFT JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id = s.member_id AND c.is_current
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_load,
 (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) AS max_member_from,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL) AS odd_tier,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND join_date > valid_from) AS join_after_from,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND join_date > DATE '2026-10-08') AS joined_future
